name: Jan de Vries
bio:
Jan's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for circuit racing. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering from Delft University of Technology, Jan worked on vehicle dynamics for several years before transitioning to the world of racing simulators. He now focuses on refining the simulator experience for Prema Junior drivers, meticulously calibrating the software and hardware to mirror real-world conditions. Known for his methodical approach and calm demeanor, Jan is a valuable asset to the team, always striving for incremental improvements that can give Prema's drivers a competitive edge.

His distinctive approach stems from a deep understanding of both the engineering principles and the subjective feel of driving. He spends hours with drivers, collecting feedback and translating it into tangible adjustments within the simulator. Jan is also keen to explore new technologies, always looking for ways to improve the realism and effectiveness of the simulator training program.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze and a slightly weathered face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Insists on drinking his coffee black, no sugar, precisely at 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM.
Tends to speak in analogies drawn from sailing, a hobby he enjoys in his free time.
